verdict.rationale: Green and Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal consultation and visa services, not a software or data-hosting product. A user-selectable data storage region is therefore a category error for this product type. The evidence's references to 'permanent residency' concern immigration status, not data residency, and nothing shows the firm ships any data-hosting capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
